template.name: Bollinger Band Squeeze
template.entry_long: bb_upper(close,{p0},{p1}) - bb_lower(close,{p2},2) < sma(bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2),20) and close > bb_upper(close,20,2)
template.notes: Bollinger(20,2) width below its 20-bar average plus an upper-band break preserves the documented squeeze-release long setup. The exact lower-band release, session fields, and typical 2x ATR stop are not fixed percentage exits.
